+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+

+r = Robot()

+obs = r.get_obs(video='none')
+now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+pose = now[7:14].copy()
+quat = pose[3:7].copy()             # the brush points straight down
+command_log = []
+run_no = 0
+
+def save_obs(result, name):
+    global run_no
+    run_no += 1
+    result.save(str(RUNS / f'{run_no:02d}_{name}'))
+    for cam, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'{name}_{cam}.png')
+
+def submit_poses(points, name, video='none', cameras=None):
+    global pose
+    arr = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32)
+    if arr.ndim == 1:
+        arr = arr[None, :]
+    result = r.submit('ee_pose', arr, dt=0.05, video=video,
+                      cameras=cameras, note=name)
+    command_log.append({'name': name, 'actions': arr.tolist(), 'meta': result.meta})
+    pose = arr[-1].astype(float)
+    if result.meta.get('plan'):
+        bad = [p for p in result.meta['plan'] if p.get('ik_ok') is False]
+        if bad:
+            print('IK failures', name, bad[:4])
+    print(name, result.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'), result.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'pose=',pose[:3])
+    return result
+
+def segment(xyz, speed=0.10, name='move'):
+    global pose
+    target = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), quat]
+    distance = np.linalg.norm(target[:3] - pose[:3])
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / (speed * 0.05))))
+    points = np.linspace(pose, target, n + 1, axis=0)[1:]
+    return submit_poses(points, name)
+
+def hold(n, name):
+    return submit_poses(np.repeat(pose[None, :], n, axis=0), name)
+
+def paper_xy(x_mm, y_mm, center_x=-0.1, center_y=0.0):
+    """Main paper mm coordinates (origin at far-left); +X is robot-right."""
+    return np.array([center_x + 0.1135925 - y_mm/1000.0,
+                     center_y + 0.1135925 - x_mm/1000.0])
+
+def practice_xy(x_mm, y_mm):
+    """Practice sheet: 99.393 mm across, 227.185 mm far-to-near."""
+    return np.array([-0.1 + 0.1135925 - y_mm/1000.0,
+                     -0.1856 + 0.0496965 - x_mm/1000.0])
+

+segment((-.1002, .1505, .10), .10, 'ink_approach')
+segment((-.1002, .1505, .018), .035, 'dip')
+hold(20, 'dip_soak')
+segment((-.1002, .1505, .11), .04, 'ink_lift')
